name: The Black Lily Theatre Company
source:
Six performances by the Company’s dazzling players:

THE CURSE OF THE WITCH: A night in the woods between the High Priestess and her Handmaiden!

THE WONDERS OF HYPNOSIS: A wonder cure for the modern age, administered before your very eyes!

COLOSSUS OF RHODES: Where love and art collide, nothing will survive!

MISERATIONE NON MERCEDE: A live demonstration on the bleeding edge of medical science!

THE AMAZING MS. AVERY: Entertainer, comedienne, and Lady’s Lady!

THE CORRUPTION OF THE WITCH: A knight becomes a statue, a tomboy becomes a bride... and all is surrendered for the sake of love!

[From [url=https://queercodedvillains.itch.io/black-lily-theatre-company]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
公司六位亮眼选手的表演：

女巫的诅咒：女祭司和她的侍女在树林里度过的一个夜晚！

催眠的奇迹：现代的神奇疗法，在你眼前进行！

罗德巨像：当爱与艺术发生碰撞时，没有什么能幸存！

MISERATIONE NON MERCEDE：医学科学前沿的现场演示！

了不起的女士。艾弗里：艺人、喜剧演员、名媛淑女！

女巫的腐败：骑士变成雕像，假小子变成新娘……一切都为了爱而放弃！
